_about: Template for the local, untracked config/profiles.json — copy it there and replace the sample profile ids, labels, and session names with the workloads this workspace actually uses. Nothing in code names a profile; commands resolve default_profile from the local file.
_rates: Leave rate_cu_per_hour null until a lease on this workspace's Colab account measures it; null means unconfirmed, and no cost projection is fabricated.
